Patch 0.30.1 (Static menus now respect the viewport)

  • Help, Report, and Patch Notes now fit normal viewports: These static menus now cap their width and height against the current viewport instead of relying on fixed desktop dimensions.
  • Tall modal content now scrolls inside the window: Help and Report content keep their actions reachable when the viewport is short, matching the Forge menu approach from the first 0.30 slice.
  • Patch Notes stays readable on smaller screens: The Patch Notes window now keeps its history scroll inside a viewport-capped frame instead of exceeding short displays.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for responsive Help, Report, and Patch Notes menu constraints, plus 0.30.1 version presentation.

Patch 0.30.0 (Forge menus now fit the client-quality pass)

  • The 0.30 client-quality line has started: Alpha now advances to 0.30.0 with the first menu-consistency slice focused on Forge usability.
  • Forge tabs now have more usable room: The Forge window is wider and taller on normal screens while staying capped to the viewport.
  • Bottom Forge actions stay reachable: Forge content now scrolls inside the menu, so upgrade, potency, socket, insert, combine, and remove actions remain accessible when tab content gets tall.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for Forge menu sizing, internal scrolling, action-button reachability, and 0.30.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.34 (Swift state now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates swift active state and duration: Authoritative state now also replicates swift active state and duration so Swift can carry truthful remaining time in local self sync instead of relying only on local trigger guesses.
  • Swift timer detail is now more truthful: This lets local self sync and buff UI track the real remaining Swift window from server state while also fixing expired server Swift state to clear cleanly.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues one buff field at a time: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by extending status detail replication one buff field at a time, following spell focus duration with the remaining timer-backed unique speed buff case.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative swift state and duration sync, plus 0.29.34 version presentation.
